dlopen_runtime_loading.description: Imports dlopen/dlmopen (can load more code at runtime)

global_scope_strong_imports.description: Strong unversioned non-Python imports with no NEEDED provider (global scope)

global_scope_weak_imports.description: Weak unversioned imports that bind through the global scope or stay null

gnu_hash_only.description: DT_GNU_HASH without a SysV DT_HASH table

lazy_binding.description: No BIND_NOW flag; relies on the caller's RTLD_NOW or lazy PLT binding

many_load_segments.description: More than four PT_LOAD segments (patchelf-extended images)

needed_bundled.description: NEEDED a library vendored in the wheel's .libs directory

needed_os_glibc.description: NEEDED glibc components (libc, libm, libpthread, libdl, librt)

needed_unknown.description: NEEDED a library that is neither OS policy, bundled nor runtime

no_needed.description: No DT_NEEDED at all; every import binds through the global scope

nonzero_entry.description: Nonzero e_entry in an ET_DYN image

over_16m.description: Larger than the 16 MiB Lua closure per-image bound

over_256k.description: Larger than the 256 KiB Python extension-profile bound

over_64m.description: Larger than the 64 MiB inspector bound

python_api_global_scope.description: Undefined Py*/_Py* symbols with no NEEDED provider (resolved through the global scope)

python_api_missing_from_runtime.description: Python imports the selected runtime does not export (needs --runtime-library)

tls_initial_exec.description: Initial-exec TLS relocations (TLS_TPREL64) that consume static TLS surplus under dlopen

unversioned_bundled_imports.description: Unversioned imports satisfied by another image of the same wheel

unwind_imports.description: Imports libgcc_s unwinder entry points (_Unwind_*) or C++ EH personality

verdef.description: DT_VERDEF: the image defines its own symbol versions

version_hidden.description: Hidden symbol-version bit on dynamic symbols

weak_undefined.description: Weak undefined symbols beyond the three compiler hooks
